title: Production backend contract and catalogue security verification
summary: The privileged aggregate verifier passed every database, privacy, catalogue, pricing, image, audit, realtime, and least-privilege invariant; fresh hosted-platform checks remain healthy and the complete release audit passes.

checks.name: Backend contract version
checks.detail: The expected and observed production backend contract versions both equal 2026-07-16.10.

checks.name: Catalogue governance
checks.detail: The verifier found 2200 approved live consumer products, 25 taxonomy pairs, and no approval or rejection audit gaps.

checks.name: Central pricing boundary
checks.detail: The verifier found no Amazon-derived prices, no current pharmacy-specific catalogue prices, and no public stock support.

checks.name: Least-privilege boundary
checks.detail: Every expected protected table and function boundary passed without unexpected anonymous or authenticated access.

checks.name: Database SSL enforcement
checks.detail: The production management configuration reports database SSL enforcement enabled and successfully applied.

checks.name: Database advisor scope
checks.detail: The shared project reports 95 security findings and 109 performance findings. MED+250 has zero performance warnings; its security warnings are limited to the intentional catalogue GraphQL surface, the exact ownership-checked authenticated RPC allowlist, and required anonymous customer sign-in. Ten informational RLS-without-policy findings are deliberate deny-by-default tables.

checks.name: Authentication configuration
checks.detail: Production reports Turnstile enabled, anonymous customer identities enabled, refresh-token rotation enabled, a one-hour JWT lifetime, and an anonymous-user rate-limit value of 30. Missing and invalid Turnstile tokens were rejected without changing the aggregate Auth user count; the valid-widget and rate-limit approval tests remain owner-controlled gates.

checks.name: Product-image reuse-rights boundary
checks.detail: The live contract reports zero unsafe public images, zero partial galleries, zero catalogue image links, an empty public Storage bucket, a validated explicit-rights constraint, verified-only public RLS, an enabled independent approval trigger, and an enabled DDL governance guard.

checks.name: Product-image DDL guard
checks.detail: The live database rejected an unauthorized verified-rights constraint drop with SQLSTATE 42501, and the complete 164-test Node suite independently reproduced the protected DDL behavior in PGlite.

checks.name: Node dependency vulnerability audit
checks.detail: The complete production and development dependency tree reported zero known vulnerabilities after replacing the vulnerable development-only esbuild dependency.

checks.name: Python dependency vulnerability audit
checks.detail: All ten exactly pinned scraper and product-image dependencies reported zero known vulnerabilities in OSV; the dedicated secure Python runtime passed its dependency consistency check.

checks.name: Integrated automated regression suite
checks.detail: The complete regression run finished 164 Node tests and 43 Python pipeline tests with zero failures.

checks.name: Current hosted Supabase platform
checks.detail: Fresh management-plane verification reports the project active and healthy on PostgreSQL 17.6, with GoTrue 2.193, PostgREST 14.1 and Storage API 1.65. Database SSL enforcement remains enabled and successfully applied.

checks.name: Current SDK and runtime compatibility
checks.detail: The workspace uses TypeScript 5.9 and requires Node 22.13 or newer, satisfying the announced future TypeScript 5 requirement for supabase-js.

checks.name: Complete preview-safe release audit
checks.detail: The latest release check passed dependency audits, lint, source validation, catalogue quality, 43 Python tests, 164 Node tests, performance budgets, application build and strict Cloudflare dry run.
